fields.title: Translate Requirement into Architecture
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each legal requirement, name the technical consequence.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Right to deletion 2. Data minimization 3. Privacy by default 4. 72-hour breach notification 5. Data localization
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — deletion across all systems, data map, export. 2 — field audit, retention periods. 3 — consents not pre-selected, optional collection disabled, minimal visibility. 4 — detection, volume assessment procedure, templates, on-call rotation. 5 — geography of the database, replicas, logs, caches, subprocessors, and employee access. Takeaway: every legal requirement has concrete technical work behind it.
